picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasking Brookhaven National Laboratory and Stony Brook with building a foundation model for the national electric grid is a rare case of AI research directly targeting critical infrastructure resilience, backed by serious federal funding.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30M+ distribution to 12 Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers will help small and mid-sized manufacturers across 11 states adopt AI and robotics, a policy-driven push to diffuse AI capability well beyond elite tech hubs.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative signals growing federal investment in applying AI to domestic critical-mineral extraction, a strategically important but underexamined AI application area.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub pairs a major cloud provider with academic medicine and a large hospital system, a template for scaling clinical AI deployment through industry partnership.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's New Innovator Award funding FSU's generative-AI behavioral health tool 'Glow' reflects growing federal confidence in AI-delivered mental healthcare interventions for underserved populations.
picks.title: FSU College of Nursing receives $1.9 million award to advance AI-powered behavioral healthcare

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston chemists combining AlphaFold AI screening with atomic magnetometer quantum sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs is a genuinely novel cross-disciplinary application of AI to a major public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: A Virginia Tech engineering alum's startup building noninvasive AI-powered brain-computer bridges for amputee prosthetic control represents real-world translation of academic AI research into medical devices with direct patient impact.
picks.title: Engineering alum's medical startup aims to empower amputees with AI-linked prosthetics
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn's 'DeepGI' AI colonoscopy screening tool winning a national public-sector excellence award shows AI-assisted cancer detection moving from research into recognized clinical practice.
picks.title: Chula Medical Innovation Receives Excellence Award 2026 - Chulalongkorn University

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's AI 'digital human' avatar for early dementia detection earning a Fast Company Innovation by Design Award demonstrates external, real-world validation of AI's growing role in early clinical diagnosis.
picks.title: AI-powered early dementia-detection tool earns Texas A&M a Fast Company Innovation by Design Award – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: A UMass Amherst national poll finding only 11% of Americans support local AI data center construction, with 65% opposed across party lines, captures a public backlash that could shape AI infrastructure policy and siting decisions nationwide.
picks.title: Just 1 in 9 Americans Support AI Data Center Construction in their Local Communities, According to New UMass Amherst Poll | UMass Amherst
